name: Grade 8 IIT Practice: June Week 3 - State and Serial
description: Practice words for Grade 8 second-trimester Arduino work.

words.example: The state changed from off to on after the button press.

words.definition: A way for a device and computer to send messages.
words.example: Serial messages showed the button state on the computer.

words.definition: To move information to another place.
words.example: The Arduino can send a message when the button changes.

words.definition: To get information from another place.
words.example: The computer can receive the serial message from the board.

words.definition: A screen or tool used to watch information.
words.example: The serial monitor displayed each test reading.

words.definition: The speed used for serial messages.
words.example: The baud rate matched the speed set in the code.
The message said whether the LED was on or off.

words.definition: To use serial messages and wiring checks to find and fix a circuit problem.
words.example: The team can debug by checking whether the button wire is in the wrong row.
